product_wide_rationale: Defines the Domain ownership and knowledge shape for every Product. No child Domain can own the architecture model that defines all child Domains.
summary: Domains exclusively own code at package or module grain, with composition, test-support, and transitional mixed roots. Four typed fact kinds distinguish law from observed behavior. Product-declared boundary checks and extractors, a strict ratchet, bounded one-call retrieval, and knowledge-home setup apply to every Product. Runtime implementation and real migration remain outstanding.
title: Domains own code exclusively and hold typed facts agents query in one call
